verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Cline training opt-out, no data-usage or no-training policy, and no zero-retention guarantee. Local-model support and bring-your-own-key options are adjacent features: they may limit where data goes, but none of the evidence says data is excluded from model training. They earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
